events.title: Demo Update: Exploration Improvements and Fixes
events.summary: Greetings, Wanderers! Version 0.2.2 brings clearer maps, exploration adjustments and fixes for your next runs. Read on for the details: Exploration and Progression Clearer maps: improved how doors and room connections appear on the minimap and in the grimoire. Also fixed unvisited doors being incorrectly shown as locked. Passage to the final rooms: these rooms are now connected by a corridor without enemies or traps. events.title: Demo Update: Mimics, Combat Improvements and Fixes
events.summary: Greetings, Wanderers! What's New Mimics arrive in the demo: some coin chests may be hiding a surprise. A chance to escape when surrounded: when your character is cornered and the game detects this situation, an exclamation mark appears above them. At that moment, rolling lets you pass through regular enemies to escape. Walls and obstacles still block your path. New machine dialogue: contextual lines react to the events of your journey.
